ValidationRule.description: Development Status can not be greater than '5.Pending Business Approval' unless the Power User Group Approval Status is set to 'Approved' or 'Exempt'
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL( Power_User_Group_Approval_Status__c ,'1. Not Yet Submitted'), ISPICKVAL( Power_User_Group_Approval_Status__c ,'2. Pending Approval'), ISPICKVAL( Power_User_Group_Approval_Status__c ,'4. Flagged for Issue Resolution')), OR( ISPICKVAL(Development_Status__c, '6. Business Approved' ), ISPICKVAL(Development_Status__c, '7. Assigned to Business Owner for QA'), ISPICKVAL(Development_Status__c, '8. Ready for UAT Deployment'), ISPICKVAL(Development_Status__c, '9. Assigned to IT for QA'), ISPICKVAL(Development_Status__c, '10. Pending Business Approval in UAT' ), ISPICKVAL(Development_Status__c, '11. UAT On Hold'), ISPICKVAL(Development_Status__c, '12. Pending Change Control Approval'), ISPICKVAL(Development_Status__c, '13. Ready for Prod Deployment'), ISPICKVAL(Development_Status__c, '14. Released to Production') ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Power User Group Approval Status must be set to 'Approved' or 'Exempt' in order to advance the Development Status higher than 5. Pending Business Approval.
